title: The Rescue
sections: 列车遭袭后发现几名乘客失踪，福格决定冒着输掉赌约的风险去救帕斯帕图。
福格与志愿士兵出发，阿乌达坚持留下，列车只能继续前行。
片尾导览视角揭示帕斯帕图仍被俘，他不断高声呼救。

questions.question: Who was among the three passengers missing after the attack?

options.text: Fix.
Passepartout.
Aouda.
Colonel Proctor.

questions.explanation: 袭击后失踪者包括帕斯帕图，福格与阿乌达仍在车站。

questions.question: Why did Mr. Fogg decide to risk losing his wager?

options.text: He wanted to travel to New York faster.
He had forgotten the wager's deadline.
He believed rescuing the missing men was his duty.
He was looking for another train.

questions.explanation: 福格明白耽搁一天会错过轮船、输掉赌约，仍认为救人是自己的责任。

questions.question: How did the captain respond when Mr. Fogg insisted on going alone?

options.text: He selected thirty volunteers to accompany him.
He arrested Mr. Fogg at the fort.
He told the train driver to leave at once.
He sent Fix to lead fifty soldiers.

questions.explanation: 军官被福格的勇敢打动，选出三十位志愿士兵协助救援。

questions.question: Why did Aouda ask the engineer to delay the departing train?

options.text: She hoped to buy supplies from the fort.
She was afraid of traveling in the snow.
She needed to repair the train windows herself.
She wanted to wait for Mr. Fogg and the missing passengers.

questions.explanation: 阿乌达希望列车等福格与被救乘客回来，而不是抛下他们。

questions.question: What did Fix promise to do while Mr. Fogg was away?

options.text: Search the desert for the next steamer.
Stay with Aouda and make sure she remained safe.
Return to New York to report the incident.
Guide the train across the snowy plain.

questions.explanation: 福格出发前请费克斯照顾阿乌达，费克斯后来也承诺留下保护她。

title: Feather's Idea
sections: A Wishbit Lost in the Clover
羽毛仙子误会女孩们是猎人，在慌忙躲藏时把许愿碎片落在大片三叶草里。
仙子们终于发现四叶草，但还需要让Emma注意到它。
羽毛仙子利用气球和木棍引导Emma发现四叶草，她许愿家人好运。

questions.question: What did Sprite tell Feather about the girls?

options.text: They had already found the wishbit.
They were not fairy hunters.
They knew how to fly.
They were looking for a lost pet.

questions.explanation: Sprite明确告诉羽毛仙子这些女孩不是仙子猎人，Feather承认自己误会了。

questions.question: Where did Feather accidentally drop the wishbit?

options.text: Inside Emma's bedroom.
Next to the bicycle tires.
Into a large patch of clover.
On top of the tree.

questions.explanation: 羽毛仙子慌张地扔下wishbit，它落在密密麻麻的三叶草里。

questions.question: What did Bumble discover while the fairies searched the grass?

options.text: A clover with four leaves.
A broken watering can.
A missing birthday present.
A new fairy hunter.

questions.explanation: Bumble发现一株有四片叶子的四叶草，仙子们终于找到目标。

questions.question: How did Feather plan to help Emma notice the clover?

options.text: Put a bright lamp over the clover.
Ask Hob to write a letter to Emma.
Hide the clover inside the watering can.
Tie Emma's balloon to a stick in the ground nearby.

questions.explanation: Feather拿出Emma的气球，用木棍固定在草地上，吸引Emma走过来。

questions.question: What did Emma hope the four-leaf clover would bring?

options.text: A new bicycle for herself.
Good luck to her family.
A chance to meet the fairies.
A bigger balloon.

questions.explanation: Emma发现四叶草后，希望它能够给家人带来好运。

title: Cleaning Up
sections: 校长给四位志愿者旧安全手册、徽章和橙色肩带，让他们承担巡逻责任。
巡逻成员到处制止丢垃圾、骑扫帚和流口水，Ben担心他们过于严厉。
Jen检查清洁工作时自己摇晃梯子，险些害Winnie跌落，并把肥皂水撒了一地。

questions.question: What did Mr. Freaky give the new safety patrol to explain their duties?

options.text: A map of the hidden tunnels.
Old safety patrol handbooks.
A list of lunch recipes.
A new set of broomsticks.

questions.explanation: Mr. Freaky拿出多年前的安全手册，让巡逻队员学习其中的规则。

questions.question: What were the patrol members supposed to wear while working?

options.text: Red capes and silver helmets.
Matching gloves and boots.
Badges and bright orange sashes.
White coats and goggles.

questions.explanation: 校长发给每个成员徽章和亮橙色肩带，要求巡逻时佩戴。

questions.question: What happened when Waldo stopped the goblin in the hallway?

options.text: The goblin picked up the littered wrapper.
The goblin was sent home for the day.
The goblin dropped a new bucket of water.
The goblin repaired the broken ladder.

questions.explanation: Waldo制止乱扔垃圾，哥布林只好捡起地上的包装纸。

questions.question: Why did Jen stop Ben and Winnie from cleaning the windows?

options.text: She needed their help catching a goblin.
She was looking for her lost handbook.
She wanted to wash the windows herself.
She wanted to check whether they were following ladder safety rules.

questions.explanation: Jen翻手册检查梯子安全规范，特别询问梯子是否牢固。

questions.question: What caused the soapy water to spill all over the hallway?

options.text: Ben deliberately threw the bucket downstairs.
Jen shook the ladder, making the bucket fall.
The zombies kicked the bucket.
Waldo flew into the bucket on a broom.

questions.explanation: Jen晃动梯子导致Winnie险些跌落，水桶落下并把肥皂水洒满走廊。

title: The Journey Begins
sections: Why the Far Frontier Is So Difficult
大家讨论远疆距离之远，过去Zann父母必须传送、骑龙、步行才能抵达。
Wyssa使用装有龙鳞的装置施法，大家在仿佛极速飞行后到达炙热沙漠。
Two Days and a Surprising Confession
两天与出人意料的事实
大家发现旅程实际用了近两天，Wyssa又承认从未来过这里，众人陷入不确定。

questions.question: Why could the group not simply zap straight to the Far Frontier?

options.text: The dragons had destroyed every wormhole.
It was much too far away for ordinary zapping.
Zann had lost his ability to use magic.
The trip was forbidden by the palace.

questions.explanation: 远疆距离First City非常遥远，普通传送无法直接到达。

questions.question: How had Zann's parents completed the last part of their earlier journey?

options.text: They sailed across a dark ocean.
They took a fast train to the edge.
They walked for more than a week after releasing their dragons.
They flew all the way on dragons without stopping.

questions.explanation: 父母传送并骑龙到一定位置后，因魔力不稳定放走飞龙，再步行一个多星期。

questions.question: What did Wyssa put into her strange contraption?

options.text: Dragon scales she had collected.
A bottle of airberry juice.
A four-leaf clover.
An old map of the desert.

questions.explanation: Wyssa把收集来的龙鳞倒进由枝条、石子等组成的装置。

questions.question: What surprised Gliss about the length of their journey?

options.text: It had lasted only a few seconds.
The whole trip had taken a month.
They had traveled backward in time by a year.
It had taken almost two days, not just five minutes.

questions.explanation: Gliss以为只花了五分钟，Wyssa却说整个旅行实际持续了近两天。

questions.question: What startling truth did Wyssa reveal at the end?

options.text: She was the ruler of the Far Frontier.
She had never visited the Far Frontier before.
She had secretly followed Zann's parents there.
She had already located Morb.

questions.explanation: Wyssa最后承认自己此前从没来过远疆，与大家之前的理解不同。
